minutes_text:
MINUTES OF MARCH 3, 2026
  REGULAR MEETING OF THE SAN GABRIEL CITY COUNCIL

I  CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Menchaca called the regular meeting of the San Gabriel City Council to order at
  6:30 P.M. on Tuesday, March 3, 2026, in the Council Chamber at City Hall, 425 South
  Mission Drive, San Gabriel, California, 91776.

  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by Council Member Wu.

  ROLL CALL

  Council Members Present:  Tony Ding, Jorge Herrera Avila, John Wu, Vice Mayor
  Eric Chan, and Mayor Denise Menchaca.
  Council Members Absent:  None.
  Staff Members Present:  City Manager Mark Lazzaretto, Assistant City Attorney
  Martin Koczanowicz, Fire Chief Steven Wallace, Human

I  Resources/Risk Management Director Edward Macias,
  Finance Director William Kaholokula, Police Chief
  Edward Elizalde, Community Development Director
  David Sanchez, Public Works Director Michael Sledd,
  and Assistant City Clerk Adam Yang.

  CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  A. CONFERENCE WITH LEGAL COUNSEL - ANTICIPATED  LITIGATION
  PURSUANT TO GOVERNMENT CODE SECTION 54956.9(d)(4)

  There was no reportable action.

  ANNOUNCEMENTS

  Assistant City Clerk Yang provided information for the public on how to view the meeting.

  1. APPROVAL OF AGENDA ORDER

I  Mayor Menchaca approved the agenda order.

  2. PRESENTATIONS

  A. ATHEN'S PRESENTATION - COMPLYING WITH SB 1383

  Athens Services Senior Vice-President, Government Affairs, John Harrington made
  the presentation.

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 1 of 4  March 3, 2026
   B. WOMEN'S HISTORY MONTH

  Mayor Menchaca made the presentation.

  3. PUBLIC COMMENT

  Mandy Luu, resident, commented on a notice of code violation and expressed
  dissatisfaction with City code enforcement staff.

I  ActiveSGV Program Manager Topher Mathers spoke about the GoSGV Equity
  Membership Program that allows Participants to get around the City via pedal assist
  e-bikes.

  4. CONSENT CALENDAR

  A motion was made by Council Member Herrera Avila, seconded by Mayor Menchaca,
  to approve Consent Calendar Items 4A - 4D as presented.

  Motion carried by a vote of 5-0 as follows:

  AYES:  DING, HERRERA AVILA, WU, CHAN, MENCHACA
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  NONE

  A. APPROVAL OF MINUTES

  The City Council approved:

I  1. Minutes of the Special City Council Meeting of February 3, 2026.
  2. Minutes of the Regular City Council Meeting of February 3, 2026.

  B. MATERIAL DEMANDS

  The City Council approved February 6 and 12, 2026, Material Demands for the
  payment of City expenditures.

  C. GENERAL PLAN HOUSING ELEMENT ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT FOR THE
  2025 CALENDAR YEAR

  The City Council received and filed the information and directed staff to submit the
  housing report to the State Department of Housing and Community Development.

  D. 2025 GENERAL PLAN IMPLEMENTATION ANNUAL PROGRESS REPORT:
  JANUARY 2025 - DECEMBER 2025

I  The City Council received and filed the information and directed staff to submit the
  report to the Office of Planning and Research and State Department of Housing
  and Community Development.

  5. PUBLIC HEARING - None.

  6. CONTINUED BUSINESS - None.

  7. NEW BUSINESS

  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 2 of 4  March 3, 2026
   A. SERVICE UPDATE AND AGREEMENT WITH CHINATOWN SERVICE CENTER
  FOR CASE MANAGEMENT SERVICES IN THE AMOUNT OF $58,879.73
  ANNUALLY

  Assistant Community SeNices Director Morales-Stevens made the staff
  presentation and Director of Program Management SeNices Kerry Situ of
  Chinatown SeNice Center (CSC) was present to answer questions.

  Clarifying discussion included unduplicated versus duplicated clients, hours of

I  services provided, CSC provision of internal support for the Case Manager, seNices
  provided for non-San Gabriel residents, and CSC purchase of the previous 211 LA
  Non-Profit building in San Gabriel.

  There was no public comment.

  RECESS AND RECONVENE

  Mayor Menchaca called for a recess and left the meeting at 7:42 P.M.

  Vice Mayor Chan reconvened the meeting at 7:50 P.M. with all Council Members present
  except Mayor Menchaca.

  Discussion included seNice for neighboring cities, seNice recipient statistics,
  referrals for CalFresh, and on-site seNice for walk-ins.

  A motion was made by Council Member Ding, seconded by Vice Mayor Chan, to
  continue to partner with Chinatown SeNice Center (CSC) to provide case

I
  management seNices to the public and authorize the City Manager to execute the
  professional seNices agreement with CSC.

  Motion carried by a vote of 4-0 as follows:

  AYES:  DING, HERRERA AVILA, WU, CHAN
  NOES:  NONE
  ABSTAIN:  NONE
  ABSENT:  MENCHACA

  B. PRESENTATION AND ACCEPTANCE OF THE ANNUAL COMPREHENSIVE
  FINANCIAL REPORT AND OTHER AUDIT REPORTS FOR THE FISCAL YEAR
  ENDED JUNE 30. 2025

  Assistant Finance Director Linda Tang made the staff presentation.

  Discussion included California Public Employees Retirement System (CalPERS)
  unfunded pension liabilities, grant money secured by California Consulting,
  positive net change in the General Fund balance, and the City's relationship with

I  California Consulting.

  There was no public comment.

  The City Council received and filed the annual audit reports for the fiscal year
  ended June 30, 2025.

  8. CITY MANAGER'S REPORT

  City Manager Lazzaretto commented on his attendance at the Independent Cities
  Association conference.
  CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES  Page 3 of4  March 3, 2026
   9. COUNCIL COMMENTS AND CONFERENCE/MEETING REPORTS

  Council Member Wu reported on his attendance at the Independent Cities Association
  Winter Seminar, an appreciation ceremony hosted by Good News LA Church and the
  International Youth Fellowship, various events held in the City of San Gabriel, Sheriff
  Robert Luna Luncheon organized by the Temple City Chamber of Commerce, the
  Hong Kong Business Association of Southern California Event at the San Gabriel Hilton,
  and Lunar New Year dinner hosted by Chinese American Military Support; and

I  commented that the City's website and e-mail domain should be updated to
  sangabriel.gov.

  Council Member Herrera Avila reported that the League of California Cities has
  appointed him to the Policy and Taxation Committee.

  Council Member Ding reported on his attendance at the California Contract Cities
  Association Board of Directors meeting, Special Screening of Cairou Wonton Movie,
  9th Golden Crown Award hosted at Sheraton, IYF Appreciation Ceremony, Chinese
  American Military Support Lunar New Year Dinner 2026, Enping Association of
  Southern California Lunar New Year event, Consulate General of Vietnam Spring
  Gathering, and the Thunder International Group Grand Opening and Relocation
  Ceremony.

  Vice Mayor Chan reported that Mayor Menchaca also attended the Independent Cities
  Association Conference; reported his attendance at the Independent Cities Association
  Conference, business networking event at Lunas Bar and Grill, USC Arcadia Hospital
  event honoring Dr. Shirley Chi, Alhambra Lunar New Year Celebration with Mayor
  Menchaca, and a Gabrielino High School Speech and Debate competition.

I  Council Member Ding commented that the City of San Gabriel is hosting a Lunar New
  Year Lantern Festival on March 21 - 22, 2026.

  10. CLOSED SESSION - None.

  11. ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:54 P.M.

  Respectfully submitted:
